mapper.select: SELECT /*common.coco.getCategoryComDooText*/ DISTINCT DECODE( SUBSTR(A.BYCA_COMORG_CODE,7,1),'G', ( SELECT DISTINCT B.COMORG_NAME FROM BYCAORGL B WHERE B.COMORG_CODE = ( SELECT DISTINCT BYCA_COMORG_CODE FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE (COM_CODE = #{st_buyer} OR BYCA_COMORG_CODE = #{st_buyer}) ) ), A.COM_NAME_LOC ) FROM ICOMCMPY A WHERE (A.COM_CODE = #{st_buyer} OR A.BYCA_COMORG_CODE = #{st_buyer})

SELECT /*common.coco.getBuyerCategoryDooSearch*/ A.STD_CATEG_ID, A.CATEG_NAME, A.CATEG_TYPE, DECODE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ITEMATTR T WHERE T.STDCATEG_ID = A.STD_CATEG_ID), 0,'N','Y') AS MASTER_CHECK, DECODE(A.CATEG_TYPE,'REG','0', ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT X.BUYER_ITEM_NO) FROM ICOMBYIT X WHERE X.BUYER = A.COM_CODE AND X.CATEGORY_NO = A.STD_CATEG_ID AND X.STATUS <> 'D' AND X.PRODUCT_CLOSE_FLAG = 'N') ) AS CNT, A.CATEG_PATH , A.DEPTH , A.PID , A.CATEG_SYS_CODE
, SUBSTR(A.STD_CATEG_ID,3,1) AS STD_CATEG_NAME
, SUBSTR(A.STD_CATEG_ID,5,2) AS STD_CATEG_NAME
, SUBSTR(A.STD_CATEG_ID,8,2) AS STD_CATEG_NAME
, SUBSTR(A.STD_CATEG_ID,11,4) AS STD_CATEG_NAME
FROM ICOMBYCA A WHERE A.COM_CODE = ( SELECT DISTINCT BYCA_COMORG_CODE FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = #{st_buyer} ) AND A.PID IN (#{st_categ_code}, (SELECT PID FROM ICOMBYCA WHERE COM_CODE = A.COM_CODE AND STD_CATEG_ID = #{st_categ_code}))
AND A.DEPTH = '2'
AND A.DEPTH = '3'
AND A.DEPTH = '4'
AND A.DEPTH = '5'
ORDER BY A.STD_CATEG_ID

SELECT B.STD_CATEG_ID, B.CATEG_NAME, B.CATEG_TYPE, DECODE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ITEMATTR T WHERE T.STDCATEG_ID = A.STD_CATEG_ID), 0,'N','Y') AS MASTER_CHECK, DECODE(B.CATEG_TYPE,'REG','0', ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT X.BUYER_ITEM_NO) FROM ICOMBYIT X WHERE X.BUYER = A.COM_CODE AND X.CATEGORY_NO = A.STD_CATEG_ID AND X.STATUS <> 'D' AND X.PRODUCT_CLOSE_FLAG = 'N') ) AS CNT, B.CATEG_PATH, B.CATEG_NAME , B.DEPTH , B.PID , B.CATEG_SYS_CODE
, SUBSTR(B.STD_CATEG_ID,3,1) AS STD_CATEG_NAME
, SUBSTR(B.STD_CATEG_ID,5,2) AS STD_CATEG_NAME
, SUBSTR(B.STD_CATEG_ID,8,2) AS STD_CATEG_NAME
, SUBSTR(B.STD_CATEG_ID,11,4) AS STD_CATEG_NAME
FROM ICOMBYCA A, ICOMBYCA B WHERE A.COM_CODE = ( SELECT DISTINCT BYCA_COMORG_CODE FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE (COM_CODE = #{st_buyer} OR BYCA_COMORG_CODE = #{st_buyer}) ) AND A.COM_CODE = B.COM_CODE
AND SUBSTR(A.CATEG_SYS_CODE,0,12) = B.CATEG_SYS_CODE AND B.DEPTH = 2
AND SUBSTR(A.CATEG_SYS_CODE,0,16) = B.CATEG_SYS_CODE AND B.DEPTH = 3
AND SUBSTR(A.CATEG_SYS_CODE,0,20) = B.CATEG_SYS_CODE AND B.DEPTH = 4
AND A.STD_CATEG_ID = B.STD_CATEG_ID AND B.DEPTH = 5
AND A.CATEG_NAME LIKE '%' || #{st_searh_name} || '%'
AND A.STD_CATEG_ID IN ( SELECT DISTINCT Y.CATEGORY_NO FROM ICOMBYIT Y WHERE Y.BUYER = ( SELECT DISTINCT BYCA_COMORG_CODE FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = #{st_buyer} ) AND Y.STATUS <> 'D' AND Y.PRODUCT_CLOSE_FLAG = 'N' AND (Y.DESCRIPTION_LOC LIKE '%' || #{st_catalog} || '%' OR Y.SPECIFICATION LIKE '%' || #{st_catalog} || ''))
ORDER BY B.CATEG_SYS_CODE
